process_phases.name: Delegación al creator

process_phases.intent: Solo en delete: READ_FILE del artefacto para extraer uuid/version/hash_signature; DELETE_FILE del .md bajo directories.*.
process_phases.name: Delete físico

process_phases.intent: Invocar action:emit-domain-mutation con emitter_agent entity-manager y handoff del creator o metadatos de delete.
process_phases.name: Sello universal

process_inputs.semantic_seed: object|null; parámetros de forja para el creator hijo; ignorado en delete
